title: Multiple links with the same rel in res.links
prompt: Extend `res.links()` so that a relation can be given an array of URLs, producing one `Link` header entry per URL with the same `rel`.

fail_to_pass: res .links(obj) should set multiple links for single rel
pass_to_pass: res .links(obj) should set Link header field
res .links(obj) should set Link header field for multiple calls
